steps.title: Juniper Lane
steps.source: Turn right onto Juniper Lane and service the cluster boxes.
details: Service the cluster boxes along Juniper Lane.

steps.title: Parkside Drive
steps.source: Turn left onto Parkside Drive. Check the hold notice before continuing.
details: Check the hold notice before continuing.

steps.title: Cedar Loop
steps.source: Turn right onto Cedar Loop; service the cluster boxes.
details: Follow the loop back to Parkside Drive.

steps.title: Post Office parking lot
steps.source: Turn into the Post Office parking lot.
